results.title: [PDF] The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Shaping Cultural Narratives and ...
results.content: With the use of local data, working collaboratively with educators, and the development of ethical frameworks, AI-powered Eastern animation can be beneficial not just to the creative sector but also to educational institutions, promoting values, education, and cultural literacy through inspiring digital stories. Although extensive research has been conducted on the use of AI to automate animation and enhance digital media (Li et al., 2021; Chen & Park, 2022), the potential of AI to influence cultural narratives and values education has not been thoroughly explored in the context of Eastern animation. Methodology This qualitative review study employs a systematic methodology to investigate how artificial intelligence (AI) affects cultural narratives in Eastern animation. Ultimately, future research would further develop the themes seen throughout this review through empirical examinations of the impact of AI on narrative form, audience response, and cultural symbolism in Eastern animation.
